description:
Connor and Emma FINALLY REUINITE!

Genuinelly....

New raps, classics, you know, the standard.

J.O.E. is joined in the studio by Boorloo producer and rapper Sunny POC for a deep dive into his work as a producer, MC and collaborator. The first hour moves through tracks he has produced, performed on and helped shape across Perth’s hip-hop scene, with conversation around his creative process, collaborations and the local music community.

 
In the second hour, J.O.E. takes over with a selection spanning West Coast hip-hop, boom bap, French rap, soul and live brass featuring Tha Dogg Pound, Rapsody, The Roots, IAM, Phife Dawg, Tenampa Brass Band, 2Pac, Jill Scott and more.

with Dave Clark

Tonight's show is a slow ramp up from chilled beats with nice jazzy vibes, to tunes of some intensity

Shout outs to Jippy & MALi JO$E for that local heat

title: All City with DJ Dusty D
description:
DJ Dusty D broadcasting tonight with a the usual blend of local, international and iconic tracks from the Decade of Decadence which is the 1990s.

Keeping it real over the airwaves, we'll also be going way back with a lost throwback. GiT ready!! This is All City!!
